state: a verifiable constraint stated in text
action: a real utterance from a natural corpus
label: deterministic verifier: does the response satisfy the constraint
why_not_context_correctness: label is program verification of a stated rule, not 'is this the true continuation' retrieval; the same response appears under constraints it satisfies and violates, so action-only is near chance by construction
interpretation: SL >> 0.10 with a ~0 permutation null => the high-SL regime is REAL and measurable for genuine (programmatically verified) labels; our ten dialogue-outcome domains simply do not sample it, so the positive direction is not vacuous -- it is untested in dialogue.
